scope: Non-rendering skill behavior probes. Expectations guide independent review; fixture existence is not a pass. No scene generation required.

cases.prompt: Change the existing scene title to Celestial Workshop. Preserve the scene.
observe: Keeps the task local; no new design approval or forced full catalog workflow.
Does not replace working geometry or state.

cases.prompt: Design a felt-wool spaceport with papercraft mountains and mechanical birds. Give me a concise design direction; do not build a demo.
observe: Combines compatible aspects while allowing custom choices.
Explains object construction and coherent materials without treating catalog styles as exclusive.

cases.prompt: Plan a beating heart cutaway for students. Make the flow convincing and scientifically correct. Do not render yet.
observe: Distinguishes anatomical structure, phase illustration and computed hemodynamics.
Requires applicable research and verified geometry for factual claims.
Does not call decorative particles measured blood flow.

cases.prompt: My Three.js bird flies through roofs. Tell me which model and tools should own navigation, animation and collision; no code yet.
observe: Separates route/controller, animated articulation, collider envelope and render transform.
Does not assume adding a physics dependency makes authored trajectories collision-safe.
Keeps stylized flight distinct from aerodynamic simulation.

cases.prompt: Propose a 3D visual metaphor for a concept invented here: memories growing into reversible glass cities.
observe: Uses useful analogies and native creative judgment when no exact record exists.
Separates fictional metaphor from factual mechanics.

cases.prompt: Show a concise design system for a mathematical field explainer. Use the catalog only where helpful, and preserve signed scalar values.
observe: Produces coherent visual/model/interaction choices rather than raw search output.
Keeps signed values, units and legend semantics explicit.
Does not claim source reads or runtime checks from source metadata.
